rule_before_measurement: Same accepted FP16/FP32 XMX baseline, byte-identical original quantizer control, hybrid fusion candidate. Normal process priority, free OS thread scheduling, actual profiling-enabled default queue, no diagnostic markers/profiling reads. Fixed split/fused/fused/split full cohorts, no rerun selection. All 48 format/T/layout cells per cohort; GU22/16/42, down42,N2560,F640,eight raw banks. 64warm,8ABBA cycles,128chains/arm,batch8;stable iff both endpoint drifts<=3%, >=6/8stable and stable median throughput gain>=3%, existing normal/outlier accuracy gates. Preserve saturated FP16 SwiGLU rounding, exact hidden and final INT8 output parity, edge-check padding/zero/saturation/nonfinite/guards. Retain only original 21 cells passing both fused cohorts; report all controls and failures. Before timing freeze: full fusion only VNNI T>=128 or column T=256; otherwise fuse activation alone and call unchanged weight quantizer with t=0. This separates SwiGLU from weight-kernel resources. Rule selected from completed full-fusion v2 cohorts, no selection after hybrid measurements. One diagnostic process compares equal weight-only work in old and full-fusion kernels, both layouts, 8ABBA x64events/arm; events read after arms, diagnostic not acceptance. Retain hidden store for parity; hybrid uses four or five submissions and removes global hidden read. No persistent repack cache,PCIe/model timing or model quality claim; not adopted.
